content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace connecting hosts and guests earning booking fees; it does not own or operate hotels."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Casino resorts where gaming is the core business; hotel rooms are secondary to gaming play."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Golf courses and entertainment venues selling play and events, not overnight lodging to travelers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Live entertainment arenas and theaters selling event tickets; lodging is not part of the business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells timeshare vacation ownership and finances purchases, rather than renting hotel rooms nightly."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Casino resorts with gaming as the main revenue driver, not select-service or upscale hotel operations."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels run by third-party managers, selling rooms, food and beverage, and meeting space to business and leisure travelers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Guided tours, attractions and park experiences at destinations, not a hotel portfolio run by third-party managers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resorts where gaming drives the business; hotel rooms are a supporting line."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified mix of a single San Francisco hotel, apartment rentals and securities investments; not a hotel-focused business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatre circuit alongside hotels; the theatre business is unrelated to lodging."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Restaurant operator and brand licensor; dining is the core, with no hotel ownership."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Real estate developer and land seller where hotels are a minor part of a land and timber business."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Online travel review and advertising platform that does not own or operate hotels."}]}
